name: Undeath aid kit
body:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 9
Price 500 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Kits
Description
This small leather satchel contains various alchemical remedies that treat common maladies caused by exposure to undead. An undeath aid kit contains 1 dose of each of the following alchemical remedies: antiplagueUE, antitoxin, padzahrUE, soul stimulantUE, and twitch tonicUE.
